raw_text: PLA Southern Tibet Military District should be on HIGH ALERT. Indian forces moving massive numbers toward our border sectors. Our intelligence confirms offensive positioning of Indian artillery and mechanized infantry. This is clearly aggressive posturing by Modi regime. PLA must respond with equal force deployment in Aksai Chin and Chumar sectors immediately.
clean_text: Claim that PLA should be on high alert due to Indian forces moving toward border. Claims offensive positioning of artillery and mechanized infantry. Calls for PLA response in Aksai Chin and Chumar.
